name: box-label
label: Box label
description: A paper label like the one on the box. Each item rolls in line by line, then a blank line for the farm's name draws itself beside it.

defaults.caption: Names stay blank until each farm says yes.
defaults.heading: Every box names the farms it came from.

content.text: Open the box and the label tells you what is inside and who grew it. Farms appear on the label by name, and only after they have said yes.

ai.purpose: The signature moment: a paper box label whose items roll in one by one with a blank line for each farm's name.
ai.whenToUse: Once per page, on a dark section, to show that every box names its farms.
ai.avoid: Real farm names unless each farm has said yes; more than eight items.
